checks.message: Boundary is provisional (`official_boundary=false`), 1 feature, derived from the coordinate range published in the announcement. Must be replaced with the official redline before professional scoring; all downstream metrics must be recomputed on release.
Three required key areas present (众智园/AI原点社区/大钟寺), all provisional. Replace with official polygons before professional scoring.

386 land-use features covering the full site boundary without overlap, classified against MNR land-use codes (dominant classes: 16 留白用地 27.1%, 0701 城镇住宅 23.7%, 0804 教育 22.8%). Not derived from simple boundary partitioning; built from OSM current-condition evidence plus agent classification judgment.

green_ratio=0.071588 is the OSM-measured lower bound (union of explicitly tagged green-space features), not a planning green-ratio target. Two alternative caveat-bearing readings (street-block estimate 0.1255; union-with-adjacent-open-space 0.1527) are disclosed in metrics.json assumptions but not used as the reported value. Do not compare this figure directly to any statutory green-ratio control.

通证翼 and 践证翼 geometry is agent-proposed (`AI_SERVICE_ZONE`, editable_by_agent=true, 3 features: WING-PRACTICE-01/02, WING-EXCHANGE-01), anchored to OSM current-condition road network and Xiaoyuehe waterway data. Carried in geometry/constraints.geojson because ALLOWED_GEOMETRY_FILES (validate_submission.py:138) is a closed set of nine filenames; AI_SERVICE_ZONE is a legal `layer` value (enums/layers.json) but not a legal standalone filename. Placed in constraints rather than public_space so it does not enter the public_space_ratio recomputation. Not written into KEY_AREA. Explicitly disclosed as design proposal, not official boundary.

Verified by running `python3 scripts/visual_review.py submissions/UncleJ-h/urbanos-studio` after finalize: Result PASS, exit code 0. Offline static HTML with no remote resources; data-value attributes reconcile with metrics.json within the 1e-6 tolerance.

Proposal contains inline references to all required standard/depth/source/data/metric categories across all 13 required sections; each section carries at least one evidence marker and no block exceeds the 8-total/3-consecutive reference density limits.
